attempts.summary: Configured chrony on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) as the internal NTP server for the cluster — added `allow 10.100.35.0/24` and `local stratum 10` to /etc/chrony.conf, opened the firewalld ntp service — while node1 continues syncing from the public pool for accuracy. Configured node2 to point exclusively at node1 (`server 10.100.35.10 iburst`, removed the public pool line). Verified node2 syncs against node1 (chronyc sources shows node1 as `^*` current best source, Reference ID 10.100.35.10) and node1 shows node2 as an active NTP client. Then ran the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot IDs and healthy chrony state, restarted node1 first and confirmed boot-ID change plus config/firewall persistence and successful public-pool resync, then restarted node2 and confirmed boot-ID change plus persisted client config and successful resync against node1.
